display_information.name: PawsOps Client Updates
display_information.description: Drafts photo updates for dog owners. Staff approve before anything is sent.
display_information.long_description:
Mention me with a photo and say "send Max's owner an update". I draft the email, you approve it, then I send it.

Drafts photo updates for dog owners. Staff approve before anything is sent.

This agent was built on PawsOps and deployed to Slack as its own app for Paws & Stay, a dog boarding business with three locations. All data in this demo is sample data.
